scripts.build:examples: echo Building example instances... && mkdir -p $PROJECT_CWD/app/public/instances && mkdir -p $PROJECT_CWD/app/public/instances/@pcms && cd $PROJECT_CWD/app/public/instances/my-contact-card && zip -r ../my-contact-card.zip . && echo Done with example instances.
scripts.build: yarn build:examples && yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --include 'packages/*' run build && yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --include 'templates/*' run build
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --include 'packages/*' run typecheck && yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --include 'templates/*' run typecheck
scripts.test: yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --include 'packages/*' run test && yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --include 'templates/*' run test
